en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with a tall medieval city gate tower at the left, traditional gabled houses with shops and inns in the middle, and a stone fountain with a column and statue in the foreground where several children are sitting on the basin edge. The cobbled street curves past the fountain toward the gate. Printed captions at the bottom read "FREIBURG i. Br." and "OBERLINDEN."
